title: CI/CD & DevOps — Automated Pipelines
subtitle: Automate testing, quality, and deployment with GitHub Actions
description: Go from manual deployments to fully automated CI/CD pipelines. You'll learn GitHub Actions from scratch, automate testing and code quality, build and push Docker images in CI, deploy to cloud platforms, and set up release automation — the exact workflow used at top engineering teams. Every lesson is practical and immediately applicable to your own projects.
